entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The soldier stared at you as you pr..."
entries.dialogueText:
The soldier stared at you as you pressed the cold steel to the side of your head.

Your hand began to tremble.

You...

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "...pulled the trigger."
entries.dialogueText: ...pulled the trigger.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "...put your gun down."
entries.dialogueText: ...put your gun down.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You pointed the gun at the soldier...."
entries.dialogueText:
You pointed the gun at the soldier. A young man, no more than Franc's age, unfairly asked to die for his country.

Two more men burst in and started yelling at you to lower your weapon in broken Sordish.

You...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You put your gun down on the table,..."
entries.dialogueText:
You put your gun down on the table, begging for your life as images of your family flashed before your eyes.

The soldiers pulled you up roughly by the elbows, laughing. One of them spat in your face and called you a coward.

You...

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "...pulled the trigger."
entries.dialogueText: ...pulled the trigger.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "...thought there might still be a w..."
entries.dialogueText: ...thought there might still be a way out of this.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "...vowed to yourself that they woul..."
entries.dialogueText: ...vowed to yourself that they would pay.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "...closed your eyes and accepted wh..."
entries.dialogueText: ...closed your eyes and accepted whatever might happen.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "...punched him in the face."
entries.dialogueText: ...punched him in the face.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The soldier reeled back, then re-tr..."
entries.dialogueText:
The soldier reeled back, then re-trained his gun on you, sneering.

You prepared for the end.

Another one of the men approached you and hit you with the headstock of his rifle.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They laughed after detaining you. T..."
entries.dialogueText:
They laughed after detaining you. They started taking photos with you.

They cheerfully carried you to a personnel truck while singing Rumburgian victory songs.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As you hesitated, the soldier snatc..."
entries.dialogueText:
As you hesitated, the soldier snatched the gun out of your hand. He and his men moved in on you and began to beat you mercilessly, until your face was bleeding and your eyes had swollen shut.

They cheerfully carried you to a personnel truck while singing Rumburgian victory songs.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Your life flashed before your eyes."
entries.dialogueText:
Your life flashed before your eyes.

You thought of happy times, sad times, all the decisions you had made that led you to this very moment.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "And so Anton Rayne was no more."
entries.dialogueText: And so Anton Rayne was no more.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "Your journey to the enemy territory..."
entries.dialogueText: Your journey to the enemy territory began.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The young soldier collapsed motionl..."
entries.dialogueText:
The young soldier collapsed motionless. 

Swearing, his reinforcements aimed their rifles at you. You managed to kill another one in the melee.

When the gunfire ended, you looked down to your body.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "Blood was everywhere."
entries.dialogueText: Blood was everywhere.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "...prayed the soldiers would spare..."
entries.dialogueText: ...prayed the soldiers would spare them.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "...told them it was all going to be..."
entries.dialogueText: ...told them it was all going to be okay.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "...said you were sorry for everythi..."
entries.dialogueText: ...said you were sorry for everything.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Your voice only came out as a quiet..."
entries.dialogueText:
Your voice only came out as a quiet whisper. Yet you knew that they had heard what you said.

You started to feel so tired that you couldn't keep your eyes open. You decided to rest for just a moment.

After taking a deep breath, you closed your eyes.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You started to feel so tired that y..."
entries.dialogueText:
You started to feel so tired that you couldn't keep your eyes open. You decided to rest for just a moment.

After taking a deep breath, you closed your eyes.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "...wished that things had gone diff..."
entries.dialogueText: ...wished that things had gone differently.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "...felt no regrets."
entries.dialogueText: ...felt no regrets.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "...cursed your luck."
entries.dialogueText: ...cursed your luck.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You started to feel so tired that y..."
entries.dialogueText:
You started to feel so tired that you couldn't keep your eyes open. You decided to rest for just a moment.

After taking a deep breath, you closed your eyes.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "...said you were sorry for everythi..."
entries.dialogueText: ...said you were sorry for everything.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "...told your family it was all goin..."
entries.dialogueText: ...told your family it was all going to be okay.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "...begged the soldiers to leave the..."
entries.dialogueText: ...begged the soldiers to leave them alone.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You put your gun down on the table,..."
entries.dialogueText:
You put your gun down on the table, begging for the lives of your family.

The soldiers pulled you up roughly by the elbows, laughing. One of them spat in your face and called you a coward.

You...

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "You blacked out."
entries.dialogueText: You blacked out.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They laughed after detaining you. T..."
entries.dialogueText:
They laughed after detaining you. They started taking photos with you.

One of them grabbed the arms of your family. Their screams were heartbreaking.

You...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A soldier approached and hit you wi..."
entries.dialogueText: A soldier approached and hit you with the headstock of his rifle.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The soldier reeled back, then re-tr..."
entries.dialogueText:
The soldier reeled back, then re-trained his gun on you, sneering.

Monica cried out your name. You prepared for the end.

Another one of the men approached you and hit you with the headstock of his rifle.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "One day you were woken up with a sp..."
entries.dialogueText:
One day you were woken up with a splash of icy water.

The warden told you that the Queen would pay you a visit. You prepared a makeshift knife and hid it well.

She entered the cell. You...

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "...begged for mercy."
entries.dialogueText: ...begged for mercy.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "...tried to stab her."
entries.dialogueText: ...tried to stab her.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The prison guards quickly wrenched..."
entries.dialogueText:
The prison guards quickly wrenched the knife out of your hands.

Queen Beatrice Livingston demanded your immediate execution. 

You were forcibly brought before an electric chair.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "They strapped you to the seat."
entries.dialogueText: They strapped you to the seat.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The metal cap was put on your head..."
entries.dialogueText:
The metal cap was put on your head without wetting the sponge.

The Queen pulled the lever.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Queen Beatrice smiled and gestured..."
entries.dialogueText:
Queen Beatrice smiled and gestured down towards her shoes.

You...

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "...told her you'd rather die."
entries.dialogueText: ...told her you'd rather die.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "...knelt down and kissed her feet."
entries.dialogueText: ...knelt down and kissed her feet.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With a haughty laugh, she left your..."
entries.dialogueText:
With a haughty laugh, she left your cell.

You never saw her again.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She laughed at your humiliation and..."
entries.dialogueText:
She laughed at your humiliation and left the cell.

You never saw her again.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Many years passed, with every day e..."
entries.dialogueText:
Many years passed, with every day exactly like the one before it. You lived in complete isolation.

You knew nothing about your family, Sordland, or the state of the world outside your four walls.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "Time flies in jail."
entries.dialogueText: Time flies in jail.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "You had grown old."
entries.dialogueText: You had grown old.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You spent the rest of your years im..."
entries.dialogueText:
You spent the rest of your years imprisoned at the Tower of Thornbourg until, finally, your body gave in.

With a deep sigh, you closed your eyes for one last time.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In Rumburg, they locked you in a pr..."
entries.dialogueText:
In Rumburg, they locked you in a prison cell.

Hours turned into days and days turned into weeks. Guards and soldiers tormented you from dusk until dawn, scarring your mind and body long after you'd told them everything you knew about Sordland and your presidency.

You asked about your family, but none of your questions were answered.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "When would it end?"
entries.dialogueText: When would it end?

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "By the time you came to yourself, y..."
entries.dialogueText:
By the time you came to yourself, you were in a Rumburg prison cell.

Hours turned into days and days turned into weeks. Guards and soldiers tormented you from dusk until dawn, scarring your mind and body long after you'd told them everything you knew about Sordland and your presidency.

You asked about your family, but none of your questions were answered.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You reached into your pocket and pu..."
entries.dialogueText:
You reached into your pocket and pulled out a crumpled family photo. You, Monica, Franc and Deana, posing proudly on the day of your inauguration.

Your bloody fingers stained the print.

You...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You looked at the other side of the..."
entries.dialogueText:
You looked at the other side of the room. Monica, Deana and Franc were yelling and reaching out to you.

Soldiers grabbed their arms. Their screams were heartbreaking.

As you were fading away, you...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You looked at the other side of the..."
entries.dialogueText:
You looked at the other side of the room. Monica and Deana were yelling and reaching out to you.

Soldiers grabbed their arms. Their screams were heartbreaking.

As you were fading away, you...
